heads: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target is this 4-column 3-row atlas of twelve blank game character head sprites. Remove ALL contrasting muzzle/chin/cheek/eye-mask color patches that imply where eyes or mouth must go. Every head must have one uninterrupted base-color face field, so independent eye/mouth sprites can be freely placed. Keep exact 4x3 grid, each head size/location, outer silhouette, ears/horns and palette, transparent background. Row1: brown mouse remove cream muzzle; tan fox remove cream muzzle; olive owl remove cream heart mask; orange squirrel remove cream cheek patches. Row2: red lizard remove yellow chin patch AND nose/nostrils/snouted projection, make smooth round face; yellow puffer remove cream bottom patch; blue owl remove pale paired mask, keep forehead moon; mummy cat remove central bandage lines, keep tiny edge bandage accents. Row3: dark blue penguin remove white mask; wooden chest remove central horizontal belt/buckle and central plank lines, keep gold fittings only on outer perimeter; brass bear remove internal forehead plate/seams/central screw, keep metal accents on perimeter and ears; golden bear remove central brown stripe. Each face blank base color with subtle broad shading only. Do not add eyes, nose, mouth, eyebrows or facial details. Keep thick black outlines and simple game art. Output 2048x1536.
parts: Use case: stylized-concept. Production 2D cartoon game facial PARTS sprite atlas, exactly 3 columns by 2 rows equal grid on transparent 1536x1024 canvas. Each item centered in its cell, generous empty padding, isolated. TOP LEFT: one perfectly circular WHITE eye sclera with smooth thick black outline, absolutely no pupil, circle width equals height. TOP MIDDLE: one perfectly circular solid BLACK pupil, with one small white round glint upper right, circle width equals height. TOP RIGHT: single thick black angry eyebrow diagonal descending from upper left to lower right, gently tapered outer left end, strong rounded inner right end. BOTTOM LEFT: mirrored angry eyebrow ascending from lower left to upper right, heavy rounded inner left end. BOTTOM MIDDLE: a single blink closed-eye arc, nearly horizontal shallow U curve in thick smooth black with rounded ends, no fill. BOTTOM RIGHT: leave completely empty. No text, labels, head, body, face, mouth, grids, extra marks, shadows. Clean sharp black outlines consistent friendly cartoon game assets. Sclera and pupil are circles, never vertical ovals.
